content.name: Fog Cloud
entries: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is {@quickref Vision and Light|SRD51|2||heavily obscured}. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the radius of the fog increases by 20 feet for each slot level above 1st.

content.name: Fog Cloud
entries: You create a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Sphere} of fog centered on a point within range. The {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Sphere} is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|SRD52}. It lasts for the duration or until a strong wind (such as one created by {@spell Gust of Wind|SRD52}) disperses it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The fog's radius increases by 20 feet for each spell slot level above 1.
